title: Letter Regarding George A.W. Kruthaup

page_data.en:
D. 4047.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTR.
D 4047
22/9/32

September 22, 32.

Sir,
I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter of September 20, enclosing a copy of a
circular issued by the United States Post Office
regarding George A.W. Kruthaup, who is wanted on a
charge of embezzlement, and to inform you that the
matter will receive attention.
I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
(sgd) F. W. Garrard
Commissioner of Police.

Edwin S. Cunningham, Esq.,
American Consul General,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与侦缉科登记室
D 4047
1932年9月22日

1932年9月22日。

先生：
谨此确认收到您9月20日来函，随函附上美国邮政局发布的一份关于乔治·A·W·克鲁索普（George A.W. Kruthaup）的通缉通告副本，此人因涉嫌挪用公款罪被通缉。特此告知，此事将予以关注。
谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
（签名）F. W. 加拉德
警务处处长。

埃德温·S·坎宁安 先生，
美国驻上海总领事，
上海。

kmB

DEPARTMENT OF STATE

AMERICAN CONSULAR SERVICE

American Consulate General,
Shanghai, China, September 20, 1932.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
B. REGISTRY
4047
21 / 9 / 32

Subject: George A. W. Kruthaup, wanted by
U. S. Post Office Authorities on
Charge of Embezzlement.

Major F. W. Gerrard, C.I.E.,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
18 Hankow Road,
Shanghai, China.

Sir:

1/ I have the honor to transmit herewith a copy of
a circular issued by the United States Post Office
Department regarding George A. W. Kruthaup, who is
wanted by that department for the embezzlement of
postal funds and the theft of blank post office money
orders. It has been reported that Kruthaup is headed
for the Orient, and if you secure any trace of him
it will be appreciated if you will communicate with
Mr. Thurston R. Porter, Marshal of the United States
Court for China, No. 250 Kiangse Road, telephone
number 11199.

I have the honor to be, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Edwin S. Cunningham,
American Consul General.

Enclosure:
1/- Circular, as stated.
